articles.title: OpenAI rebuts Apple trade secrets allegations in new response with receipts
articles.description: Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI last month, accusing the firm behind ChatGPT of stealing trade secrets related to hardware development. Nearly a month later, OpenAI has published a detailed response to many of Apple’s claims in the form of a blog post.

articles.title: Apple sued over alleged lack of age checks for casino games in Brazil
articles.description: Apple is facing a civil lawsuit in Brazil seeking R$300 million (roughly $59 million) in damages over allegations that children can download and access casino-style games on the App Store without any meaningful age verification. Here are the details.

articles.title: Apple plans to open iPhone clipboard access to Windows PCs
articles.description: Apple has outlined plans to let users copy and paste content between an iPhone and a Windows PC, following an interoperability request from Microsoft in the European Union. Here are the details.

articles.title: Russia escalates dispute with Apple over mandatory app preinstallation
articles.description: Reuters reports that Russia’s antitrust regulator has opened a formal case against Apple over the company’s failure to preinstall the state-backed MAX messenger and Russia’s RuStore app marketplace on its devices. Here are the details.

articles.description:

In a new post today, John Gruber at Daring Fireball has a likely explanation for this requirement.

articles.title: Apple Photos in iOS 27 gets camera roll feature it’s long needed
articles.description: iOS 27 is a big update for Apple’s Photos app, with improvements to slideshows, shared albums, and more. It also adds a welcome camera roll-type feature many have long been asking for: ‘Captured by Me.’

articles.title: Apple’s contract manufacturing tax breaks in India could be extended to 2041

articles.description: John Ternus is officially set to take over as Apple CEO on September 1. Ahead of that, he’s shaping the team around him and has brought back a key hardware engineering executive who retired several years ago.
